Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one opaque full-bleed native1254-square game-map detail for r09_c08/r04_c02. Image1 gives exact framing, scale and existing object footprints. The TOP115 rows and RIGHTMOST115 columns are native neighbor references: preserve existing contours, grooves, materials and shadow endpoints at their exact coordinates; north wins the shared top-right corner. Rows115..229 and columns1024..1138 contain guide-only soft transitions into regional context. Rebuild those into continuous painting; never copy guide bounds as walls, steps, dark bars, abrupt texture changes or truncated grooves. Reconstruct the soft interior as crisp native detail. Image2 is the user-approved primary painting/material style: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy with smooth readable bevels and restrained low-contrast surfaces. Copy no UI, text, symbols, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Keep ONLY objects and materials already present in Image1; no additions, recropping, repositioning, rotation or enlargement. Quiet ivory stone: no grit, cracks, veins, stains, bright scored scratches, harsh brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Rounded clean existing leaves. No new buildings, stairs, medallions, frames, labels or watermark. Return only this single native detail image.
Exact inventory: the existing tall RED lacquer lamp/banner post centered toward the RIGHT, clipped at top and bottom; its two red spiral brackets with small attached gold balls; gold collar; gold-bordered yellow rectangular panel completely BLANK. Keep the exact panel, post and brackets shape, size, location and clipping. At LEFT only the existing cropped green tree canopy and the lower-left ivory curved planter with cropped leaves and trunk. Preserve the top and right native leaf/post/bracket contour endpoints at exact locations, including the shared right spiral bracket; rebuild the guide transition so no leaf is cut off at a straight guide border. No new foliage groups, petals, carvings or features. Quiet near-uniform warm ivory paving with gentle diffuse shading, no diamond checkerboard, triangular facets, polygonal color blocks or added scored lines. Keep current cast shadow and existing planter rim. Absolutely no writing, symbols or ornaments on the yellow panel. Style image is materials only; copy none of its UI or characters.
